title: File:Gemini-Discovered World is Most Like Jupiter (gemini1505a).jpg

desc: An artistic conception of the Jupiter-like exoplanet, 51 Eri b, seen in the near-infrared light that shows the hot layers deep in its atmosphere glowing through clouds. title: File:Gemini-Discovered World is Most Like Jupiter (gemini1505b).tiff
art: J. Rameau (UdeM) and C. Marois (NRC Herzberg).
desc: Discovery image of 51 Eri b with the Gemini Planet Imager taken in the near-infrared light on December 18, 2014. The bright central star has been mostly removed by a hardware and software mask to enable the detection of the exoplanet one million times fainter.
